SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ............
S.1, Special Branch Section,
REPORT
Date........ June 29, 19 37.

Subject.................... Oriental Social Club

Made by.... D.S. Hocking ............ Forwarded by.... J. Boyne C.S.I

With reference to the attached letter from the
North China Daily News & Herald dated 15th June regarding an
advertisement intended for publication in the "Straits Times":
I have to report that P.O.Box 559, the address in Shanghai of
the Oriental Social Club, is rented by a Mr. Adolph Raphael
Feldger, alias Feedher, a Russian Jew, born 36 years ago
at Zeir, Amur Province, Siberia, who is residing at present
at 6, Passage 220, Route Vallon.
Feldger arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostock in
1923, since which date he has been variously employed as a
proof-reader with the now defunct Siberian Press, as a book-
keeper with the Siberian Jewellery Store, Nanking Road, and in
a similar capacity with both the China Oil Refineries Associated,
24 The Bund, and Spuncrete (North China) Ltd., 1087, East Yuhang
Road, leaving the last mentioned firm on its liquidation in the
Spring of 1934. In the same year Mr. Feldger opened up the
United Commercial Service Agency at Room 622, 133 Yuen Ming
Yuen Road, but as this venture proved a failure he, with several
other Russians, formed the Bennett Matrimonial Bureau. Application
was made to the Shanghai City Government for registration of the
concern when Mr. Feldger stated his nationality to be German,
but when it was found, on enquiry, that Mr. Feldger was not
registered with the German Consulate, his application was refused.
In the Spring of 1935 Mr. Feldger became Secretary of the Albian
Crystal Co. Ltd., merchants, at 984, Route de Ziccawei.
In July 1936 Mr. Feldger together with Mr. Diamond,
a British Lawyer, and several Russians, was associated with the
Brown Investigation Agency, with offices at Room 806, 113, Kiu-
kiang Road.

S.1，特科股，
报告
日期........ 1937年6月29日。

主题.................... 东方社交俱乐部

制作人.... D.S. Hocking ............ 转呈人.... J. Boyne C.S.I

关于附上的《字林西报》（North China Daily News & Herald）6月15日来信，信中提及拟在《海峡时报》（"Straits Times"）刊登的一则广告：
兹报告如下：东方社交俱乐部在上海的地址为邮政信箱559号，该信箱由阿道夫·拉斐尔·费尔德格（Adolph Raphael Feldger）先生租用，别名 Feedher，系俄罗斯犹太人，36年前出生于西伯利亚阿穆尔省泽伊尔（Zeir, Amur Province, Siberia），现居住于华伦路（Route Vallon）220弄6号。
费尔德格于1923年从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海，此后曾受雇于多家机构，包括在现已停办的《西伯利亚报》（Siberian Press）担任校对员，在南京路的西伯利亚珠宝店（Siberian Jewellery Store）担任簿记员，以及在外滩24号的中国联合炼油公司（China Oil Refineries Associated）和东余杭路1087号的斯邦克里特（华北）有限公司（Spuncrete (North China) Ltd.）担任类似职务，并于1934年春季最后一家公司清算时离职。同年，费尔德格先生在圆明园路133号622室开设了联合商业服务社（United Commercial Service Agency），但因该经营失败，他与其他几名俄国人共同组建了贝内特婚姻介绍所（Bennett Matrimonial Bureau）。在向上海市政府申请注册该企业时，费尔德格先生声称其国籍为德国，但经查询发现费尔德格先生并未在德国领事馆注册，因此其申请被拒。
1935年春季，费尔德格先生成为位于徐家汇路984号的阿尔比安水晶有限公司（Albian Crystal Co. Ltd.，商号）的秘书。
1936年7月，费尔德格先生与英国律师戴蒙德（Diamond）先生及几名俄国人合伙成立了布朗调查社（Brown Investigation Agency），办公地点位于九江路113号806室。

So far as has been ascertained Mr. Feldger has at
no time done anything discreditable in his association with
the above mentioned concerns. His present venture, The Oriental
Social Club, would appear to be similar in nature to some of
his other undertakings. For some reason which has not been
ascertained he does not appear to be in the least interested in
local application for membership of his club as letters addressed
to Box 559 asking for particulars have remained unanswered.
There is nothing in French Police records
detrimental to his character or morals.

D.S. Hocking.
D. S.

（左侧手写批注：）

curious point.

据目前查明，费尔德格先生在上述各机构的任职期间，从未有过任何有损声誉的行为。他目前的创业项目“东方社交俱乐部”在性质上似乎与他之前的其他经营活动类似。出于某种尚未查明的原因，他似乎对当地的入会申请毫无兴趣，因为寄往559号信箱询问详情的信件均未得到回复。
法国警察局的档案中没有任何不利于其品行或道德的记录。

D.S. Hocking.
D. S.

一奇怪之处。

SHANGHAI
June 15, 1937

Major K. M. Bourne,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Foochow Road.

Dear Major Bourne,

The "Straits Times," Singapore, have been asked
to insert the attached advertisement in their paper and have written
to me to ask my views about the club, as they do not wish to accept
the advertisement unless they know more about it.

Possibly it is known to your department, in which
case I shall be very glad to pass any opinion on to the "Straits Times."
Perhaps you will return the copy in due course.

Yours sincerely,

R W Davis

Si.
Return early please

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH / 16 JUNE 1937 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

Date October 26, 1938

Subject (in full) Oriental Social Club.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C Crawford D.I.

Interviewed on October 24, 1938 in connection with his
application to join the Jewish Company, S.V.C., Mr. A.R. Felder,
renter of the P.O.Box 559 in Shanghai - the address of the Ori-
ental Social Club, stated inter alia that this club is still in
the period of formation. One of the principal promoters of the
club seems to be a certain Mr. Leo Prentice, who is reported to
be in Manila at present.

Mr. Felder furnished the attached pamphlet describing
the aims pursued by the Oriental Social Club.

There is a possibility that Mr. Leo Prentice is iden-
tical with one Prentice, unrecognized American, one of the or-
ganizers of the Cosmopolitan Clothing Club, 16 Central Arcade,
in September, 1933. ( File D-5561 ).

D.S.I. Prokofiev.
A.P. & 26/10.

G. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

P.A. to D C Sp. B! C. ( Special Branch ).

主题（全称） 东方社交俱乐部。

制作人 D.S.I. Prokofiev. 转呈人 C Crawford D.I.

A.R. Felder 先生于1938年10月24日因申请加入犹太连队（Jewish Company, S.V.C.）而接受问询，他是上海邮政信箱559号（即东方社交俱乐部的地址）的承租人，他在陈述中提到，该俱乐部仍处于组建阶段。该俱乐部的主要发起人之一似乎是一位名叫 Leo Prentice 的人，据报道此人目前在马尼拉。

费尔德先生提供了附件中的小册子，描述了东方社交俱乐部所追求的目标。

Leo Prentice 先生有可能与1933年9月在中央商场16号成立的大都会服装俱乐部（Cosmopolitan Clothing Club）的组织者之一、未被承认的美国公民 Prentice 为同一人。（档案 D-5561）。

D.S.I. Prokofiev.
A.P. & 26/10.

G. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

呈特科副督察长 C. ( Special Branch )。
